Chapter 6 - Types, Constants, and Global Functions / Types and Constants
Cyberdog Streams

Data Size

The following constants represent values that can be returned by the CyberStream::GetTotalDataSize method (page 386).
kCDTotalDataSizeUnknown
The number of bytes of data to be downloaded is unknown.
kCDTotalDataSizeUnknowable
The number of bytes of data to be downloaded is unavailable.
